name: weekly-digest
trigger: More merged pull requests in a week than the owner reads one by one, or several people merging.
adds: A weekly issue that gathers the Decisions section of every pull request merged that week, so that decisions are read in one sitting instead of approved one by one.
limits: It reads what sessions wrote: a decision that was taken and not written is not in it.
It needs a label named digest in the repository.
Not exercised on a real repository by this plugin's tests: they check the text it builds, not the workflow.
